skill.name: skywork-music-maker
skill.description: Generate songs, instrumentals, lyrics, and reference-based tracks with Mureka AI from structured natural language music prompts.
skill.summary: Turn music ideas into Mureka-ready prompts, lyrics, songs, and instrumental tracks.
skill.author: SkyworkAI

security_audit.summary: Most high static findings are false positives from Markdown code spans, setup documentation, and placeholder API key names. Confirmed risks are the real Mureka network client, environment access to MUREKA_API_KEY, local output writes, and third-party upload behavior. Semantic review also found a high-risk vocal cloning consent issue; no prompt injection attempt was found.

remediation.issue: Mureka API key is read from the environment and used for external requests.
remediation.suggestion: Document that the key is sent only to Mureka, avoid logging it, and recommend a least-privilege Mureka key when available.

remediation.issue: User-selected files can be uploaded to a third-party API.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit confirmation of the file path, destination service, purpose, and rights before any upload command runs.

remediation.issue: Vocal cloning can be used without consent guardrails.
remediation.suggestion: Add clear policy text requiring consent and ownership rights, and instruct agents to refuse impersonation or unauthorized voice use.

remediation.issue: Generated lyrics and audio are written to user-selected output directories.
remediation.suggestion: Confirm the output directory before writing and warn when fixed filenames such as lyrics.txt or audio.mp3 may be overwritten.

semantic_findings.title: Vocal Cloning Consent Risk

semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The documentation explicitly describes a vocal cloning workflow using uploaded voice samples and generated songs. The risk is contextual misuse, not a syntax pattern.

semantic_findings.title: User File Uploads Sent To Third-Party API
semantic_findings.description: The upload command accepts a local file path and posts the file to Mureka with a selected purpose. A misdirected agent could upload sensitive local audio or other chosen files to the external service.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The code opens the provided path in binary mode and sends it in a requests.post file upload. The argparse path accepts user-selected local files for the upload subcommand.

content.value_statement: Turning a rough music idea into a usable AI generation prompt is difficult. This skill guides prompt structure, lyrics, Mureka API generation, reference uploads, and audio downloads.
actual_capabilities: Converts natural language music requests into structured Mureka prompts.
Generates or extends lyrics through the Mureka lyrics workflow.
Generates songs with lyrics and vocals through the bundled Python CLI.
Generates instrumental tracks with prompt or reference controls.
Uploads reference, vocal, melody, and instrumental files for Mureka control options.
Downloads generated audio in mp3, flac, or wav formats.
limitations: Requires a Mureka API key and network access to api.mureka.ai.
Generation quality, wait time, and billing depend on the Mureka account and service.
Voice cloning and reference uploads require consent and rights to the source audio.
The CLI writes files to the selected output directory and may overwrite existing names.

use_cases.title: Create Video Background Music
use_cases.description: Generate calm, branded, or cinematic instrumental tracks from a short creative brief.

use_cases.title: Draft Song Demos
use_cases.description: Turn a theme into lyrics, a structured style prompt, and a generated vocal song demo.

use_cases.title: Prototype Game Audio
use_cases.description: Create mood-specific loops or scene music using genre, tempo, instrument, and reference controls.

prompt_templates.title: Create A Simple Song
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a warm pop song about starting over. Suggest a structured Mureka prompt, write short lyrics, and ask before generation.

prompt_templates.title: Generate Background Music
prompt_templates.scenario: Instrumental track for a media project.
prompt_templates.prompt: Make a calm instrumental track for a product video. Use a specific genre, BPM, instruments, mood arc, and no vocals.

prompt_templates.title: Refine Lyrics And Style
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate workflow for a full song demo.
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me create a nostalgic indie pop demo. Write verse and chorus lyrics, keep lines short, then prepare the Mureka prompt.

prompt_templates.title: Use References Safely
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced workflow with uploaded audio controls.
prompt_templates.prompt: I have rights to a 30 second reference track. Plan a reference-based song workflow, confirm upload consent, and explain the control limits.

output_examples.input: A creator asks for chill background music for a tutorial video.
output_examples.output: The skill returns a detailed instrumental prompt with genre, tempo, instruments, mood, and an external API confirmation step.

output_examples.input: A songwriter asks for a demo about leaving home.
output_examples.output: The skill drafts short structured lyrics, prepares a matching style prompt, and saves generated results in the chosen folder.

output_examples.input: A producer wants to use a vocal sample they own.
output_examples.output: The skill explains vocal upload requirements, confirms consent, and uses the returned file ID for Mureka generation.

best_practices: Include genre, BPM, instruments, vocal style, and mood progression before generation.
Confirm API use, billing, output directory, and any file upload before running the CLI.
Use short lyric lines and section tags such as Verse, Chorus, Bridge, and Outro.
anti_patterns: Do not ask for imitation of a living artist or a copyrighted vocal identity.
Do not upload voice, melody, or reference audio without clear rights and consent.
Do not generate from vague prompts without user confirmation of style and output location.

faq.question: Does this skill work without a Mureka API key?
faq.answer: No. It requires MUREKA_API_KEY in the environment before any API generation or upload can run.

faq.question: Can it create both songs and instrumentals?
faq.answer: Yes. The bundled CLI supports song, instrumental, lyrics, and upload workflows.

faq.question: Does it upload my files to a third-party service?
faq.answer: Yes. Upload and generation commands send selected content to Mureka AI. Confirm the files and rights first.

faq.question: Can it clone a voice?
faq.answer: It can use Mureka vocal upload controls, but only with consent and rights to the voice sample.

faq.question: Where are generated files saved?
faq.answer: The CLI saves audio and lyrics into the output directory selected for the command.

faq.question: Which AI agent tools are supported?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
